pin-response.label: Pin response by default
pin-response.helpText: This setting affects the default value of the "Pin response" option on the pop-up.

lock-response.label: Lock response by default
lock-response.helpText: This setting affects the default value of the "Lock response" option on the pop-up.

edit-response.label: Edit response by default
edit-response.helpText: This setting affects the default value of the "Edit response" option on the pop-up.

pm-as-subreddit.label: Private message as subreddit by default
pm-as-subreddit.helpText: This setting affects the default value of the "Message as subreddit" option on the pop-up.

title-keywords.label: Keywords in reason title (case-sensitive)
title-keywords.helpText: Enter a comma (,) separated list of case-sensitive keywords or phrases that MUST be in the removal reason's title for it to be included for selection in the pop-up (e.g. the word "Warning"). Works with certain special characters like brackets or quotes, but not commas. Leave blank for no title restrictions.
